items.title: Lillie Delk Christian Interview, 1961-04-25
items.q: INTERVIEWER mentions Johnny Cincere was with you too; INTERVIEWEE does not confirm or describe a personal relationship, only discusses Richard M Jones.

ctx.x: Mm hmm. And then later uh with uh uh Richard M Jones. Now this sounds as if uh uh possibly this was another date that Johnny Cincere was influential on because he was with you too. Mm hmm. And it says an unknown clarinet. Mm hmm. Do you have any idea who that might have been? This is uh the next spring. Ain't she sweet? And it all depends on you. Richard M Jones, Johnny Cincere.

Yeah. Uh Richard M Jones. I had forgotten all about him. That's true. Richard M Jones. He played piano. Uh huh. And uh let's see. Yeah. I can't think. Who played the clarinet at that time? Well now that I put the question in your mind, it may suddenly bob up two days from now. It might.
